message.content:
Civil law, also known as civil jurisprudence or civil law system, is a legal framework that governs non-criminal disputes between private parties. Its components can be broadly categorized into several key areas: | Component | Description | |-----------|-------------| | **Sources of Law** | • **Statutes & Codes** – Written laws enacted by legislatures (e.g., Civil Code, Commercial Code).
• **Case Law / Precedent** – Judicial decisions that interpret statutes and establish common‑law principles.
• **Customary Law** – Long‑standing practices recognized as binding in certain contexts. | | **Legal Subjects** | • **Persons** – Natural persons, legal entities (companies, NGOs).
• **Property** – Real property, movable property, intellectual property.
• **Contracts** – Agreements, obligations, performance, breach.
• **Torts** – Wrongful acts causing harm or loss.
• **Family Law** – Marriage, divorce, child custody, inheritance. | | **Procedural Elements** | • **Jurisdiction** – Determining which court has authority over a case.
• **Venue** – Specific location where a case is heard.
• **Pleadings** – Complaint, answer, counterclaim, etc.
• **Discovery** – Exchange of evidence and documents.
• **Trial & Judgment** – Presentation of evidence, deliberation, issuance of a judgment. | | **Remedies** | • **Damages** – Compensatory, punitive, nominal.
• **Specific Performance** – Court order to fulfill contractual obligations.
• **Injunctions** – Preventive orders.
• **Restitution** – Return of property or compensation. | | **Legal Principles** | • **Good Faith** – Parties act honestly and fairly.
• **Equity** – Fairness and justice beyond strict legal rules.
• **Doctrine of Res Judicata** – Finality of judgments.
• **Doctrine of Estoppel** – Preventing contradictory claims. | | **Specialized Areas** | • **Commercial Law** – Business contracts, corporate governance.
• **Consumer Protection** – Rights of buyers and sellers.
• **Environmental Law** – Regulations protecting natural resources.
• **Intellectual Property** – Patents, trademarks, copyrights. | These components interact to form a comprehensive system that resolves disputes, protects rights, and promotes orderly conduct in society.
